title: A pseudo-icosahedral cage {Gd12} based on aminomethylphosphonate

material_class.structural_family: pseudo-icosahedral {Gd12} aminomethylphosphonate cage with an encapsulated [Co(H2O)6]2+ guest

synthesis.procedure: Synthesis of 1 (SI): [CoII2(μ-OH2)(O2CtBu)4(HO2CtBu)4] (0.048 g, 0.05 mmol), [GdIII2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6] (0.154 g, 0.1 mmol) and MeCN (8 mL) were mixed and stirred for ten minutes at room temperature. NH2CH2PO3H2 (0.011 g, 0.1 mmol) was dissolved in MeOH/H2O (0.1/0.1 mL) with Et3N (0.1 mL, 1.0 mmol) as base. The mixtures were transferred into a 10 mL Teflon-lined autoclave, heated at 150 °C for 12 h, and cooled to room temperature at 0.05 °C min−1. Light pink prismatic crystals were collected, washed with MeCN and dried in air. The main text describes the same solvothermal sequence without numerical amounts.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for mixing; 150 °C solvothermal, then cooled to room temperature at 0.05 °C min−1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature; light pink prismatic crystals collected, washed with MeCN and dried in air

properties.summary: χMT decreases from 94.0 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature to 78.7 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, attributed mainly to Co(II) with possible weak antiferromagnetic Gd···Gd exchange that cannot be modelled. Magnetization reaches 81.9 μB at 2 K and 70 kG without saturation. The compound shows a large magnetocaloric effect, with a maximum magnetic entropy change of 26.7 J kg−1 K−1 for ΔH = 70 kG at 2 K.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature, 5 kG dc field, polycrystalline sample
